authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high technical quality with excellent lighting, sharp focus, and coherent composition. However, subtle generative artifacts are present: lamination layers on central and bottom-right croissants appear slightly fused/waxy rather than exhibiting crisp, separated flakes typical of real puff pastry. Some croissant tips blend softly into plate shadows instead of maintaining sharp defined edges. These textural imperfections prevent perfect authenticity but do not significantly undermine overall photorealism for most applications.
